# Social Object

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:SocialObject`](gmeow-SocialObject.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/SocialObject>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/kernel`](../../slices/kernel.md)

An entity that exists by virtue of social convention, collective acceptance, or sustained narrative practice — a myth, an urban legend, an agreement, a standpoint, or a socially-constituted institution. Distinct from [`PhysicalObject`](gmeow-PhysicalObject.md) (material) and overlapping with [`InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md) (a myth is both social and informational). No disjointness with [`InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md) is asserted so that socially-sustained narratives may carry information content without identity clash.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md), [`gufo:Object`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-object)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:SocialObject`](gmeow-SocialObject.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md), [`gufo:Object`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-object). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
